# YuvexPay

> YuvexPay is a Brazilian payment gateway. The public REST API at `https://api.yuvexpay.com/v1/*` lets developers accept payments (PIX, credit card, boleto), issue refunds, move money out via PIX withdrawals, and manage products, customers, statements and webhooks.

All requests authenticate with a YuvexPay API key sent as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer ypk_<env>_<kid>_<secret>`. `<env>` is `test` (sandbox) or `live` (production). The same base URL serves both environments.

Write endpoints (`POST /v1/payments`, `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund`, `POST /v1/withdrawals`, `POST /v1/products`, `POST /v1/customers`) require an `X-Idempotency-Key` header.

All amounts are in **BRL** as decimal numbers (e.g. `49.90`), not cents.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/quickstart): Create your first payment with a PIX QR code in under 5 minutes.
- [Authentication](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/authentication): API key format (`ypk_<env>_<kid>_<secret>`), scopes, IP allowlist, rotation, and `GET /v1/auth/self` for self-introspection.
- [Idempotency](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/idempotency): The `X-Idempotency-Key` contract: 24h TTL, 100-char limit, scoped per company and environment, payload-mismatch detection.
- [Errors](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/errors): Standard error envelope and the full code list (auth, validation, idempotency, payment, refund and withdrawal codes).
- [Rate limiting](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/rate-limiting): Per-company limits, response headers (`X-RateLimit-*`), and exponential backoff guidance.
- [Environments](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/environments): Sandbox vs. production. Same URL, different key prefix.
- [Sandbox testing](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/sandbox): Deterministic recipes. **A sandbox payment is never terminal in the `POST /v1/payments` response — a status check about 5 seconds later writes the outcome.** PIX payment cents `.01` paid, `.02` stays unpaid forever, `.03` cancelled, `.04` expired, `.05` paid (MED is not reachable from the amount), any other cents paid. The cents are ignored for `CARD` and `BOLETO`. Withdrawal cents `.01` completed, `.02`/`.03` failed, `.04` stays processing, reached synchronously. `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/simulate` forces a terminal status with no wait: `PAID` (default), `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED`, `REFUNDED`, `DISPUTED`; sandbox keys only, production keys get `403`. **Sandbox sends no webhooks to a configured endpoint, for any event type — poll `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}` and use `/simulate` instead.**
- [Payments guide](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/payments): Headless PIX, headless direct CARD, hosted multi-method checkout, and BOLETO. Lifecycle from `NEW` to `PAID`/`REFUNDED`. **A payment can be split with other YuvexPay companies through the optional `splits` array on creation: `recipientCompanyId`, `type` (`PERCENTAGE` or `FIXED`) and `value`, set at creation only — there is no endpoint to add, edit or remove a split afterwards.** Shares are computed from `amount` (the gross) and the YuvexPay fee is always the originating company's, never apportioned. `netAmount` stays pre-split: the originator keeps `netAmount` minus the sum of the splits. The sum must be `<= netAmount`, otherwise `SPLIT_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_NET` and nothing is clamped. **Percentage shares round DOWN to the cent and every remaining cent stays with the originating company.** Splitting is opt-in per company pair and the recipient accepts it in its dashboard (`SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_PENDING` until it does); the recipient can revoke at any time (`SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_REVOKED`), and **revocation is forward-only, so payments already created still settle, refund and freeze normally.** Both companies must be approved (KYC, plus KYB for a business) when the payment is created. **Recipients get no webhook and no receipt**: the payment is not theirs, `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}` returns `404` for them, and they see the money only in `GET /v1/balance`, in `GET /v1/documents/statements` and in their dashboard. A split credit follows the **recipient's own** rolling reserve policy, not the originator's. Splits are environment-locked (`SPLIT_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH`), and a payment with splits cannot be anticipated (`ANTICIPATION_SPLIT_PAYMENT`).
- [Refunds](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/refunds): Eligibility rules, lifecycle, and error codes (`REFUND_IN_PROGRESS`, `REFUND_NOT_SUPPORTED`, etc.). **Partial refunds are conditional, not unsupported: they require a payment that has already settled and a routing provider that supports them, otherwise `PARTIAL_REFUND_NOT_SUPPORTED`. A full refund is always available on a refundable payment.** On a payment with splits the refund is proportional: every party is debited in proportion to what it received, the originating company included, and partial refunds use the same proportions. A recipient that already withdrew its share goes negative and the shortfall is never moved onto the originating company, so `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE_FOR_REFUND` is measured against the originating company's share only. A PIX MED freezes each party's proportional share the same way.
- [Withdrawals](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/withdrawals): PIX-only, BRL-only, daily/nightly limits, masked `pixKey`, and the never-retry rule on ambiguous `PROCESSING` (whose horizon is hours, not minutes). **`amount` is the NET the recipient receives; the flat fee is added on top, so the balance is debited `grossAmount = amount + feeAmount`.** Gross is what `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`, the daily/nightly `used` counter and the per-transaction cap are measured against; the minimum is measured against the net and is `R$ 10.00` unless raised for the account — read `minAmount` from `GET /v1/withdrawals/limits`. The creditor document sent to the network resolves in three steps: `destination.recipientDocument` when sent, else the PIX key itself when it is a CPF or CNPJ key, else your own tax id. `creditorDocumentSource` is dashboard-only and returns `400 CREDITOR_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_NOT_SUPPORTED` on the public API. Per-transaction caps are account-dependent and come from `GET /v1/withdrawals/limits`, not a fixed platform maximum.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/webhooks): `v1` HMAC-SHA256 signature with timestamp anti-replay (`X-Webhook-Signature`, `X-Webhook-Timestamp`), at-least-once delivery, no order guarantees, retries. **The HTTP body is the bare event object — there is no `{ id, type, data }` envelope and the event name is carried only in the `X-Webhook-Event` header.** Twelve subscribable event types. `PAYMENT_PAID` carries a `payer` block (name, CPF/CNPJ, institution name + ISPB) plus the network `endToEndId`; `payer.document` carries the provider's masked string (for example `***405566**`) when no full document is on file, and is `null` only when neither was captured. `WITHDRAWAL_SENT` carries a `recipient` block, populated when the withdrawal had a recipient document. Both blocks are `null` when every field would be null. **Webhooks are delivered for production activity only: sandbox payments and withdrawals send no webhooks to a configured endpoint, for any event type, because an endpoint belongs to the account and not to an environment.** A sandbox integration polls `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}` and forces terminal outcomes with `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/simulate`; the dashboard **Send test** button delivers a signed `TEST` event to exercise a verifier.

## API reference

- [API overview](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/introduction)
- [Inspect API key](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/auth/self): `GET /v1/auth/self`
- [Create payment](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/create): `POST /v1/payments` — PIX supports `enforcePayerDocument` (best-effort same-document opt-in). Optional `splits[]` (`recipientCompanyId`, `type`, `value`) shares the payment with other YuvexPay companies; the maximum number of entries is the recipient limit configured for the account, three by default. Split failures arrive as a top-level `error.code`, not inside `VALIDATION_ERROR.details`: `SPLIT_RECIPIENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `SPLIT_SELF_RECIPIENT`, `SPLIT_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_NET`, `SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_PENDING`, `SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_REQUEST_LIMIT`, `SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_REVOKED`, `SPLIT_RECIPIENT_INACTIVE`, `SPLIT_RECIPIENT_NOT_APPROVED` and `SPLIT_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH` are `400`; `SPLIT_ORIGINATOR_NOT_APPROVED` is `403`. **`SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_PENDING` is the single answer for every recipient that cannot receive a split yet — identical whether the company ID exists or not, so it cannot be used to enumerate company IDs.** `SPLIT_RECIPIENT_INACTIVE`, `SPLIT_RECIPIENT_NOT_APPROVED` and `SPLIT_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH` are only returned for a recipient that had already accepted the relationship. There is no `SPLIT_RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND`. Outstanding consent requests are capped per company and environment (20 by default): beyond that, naming a new recipient returns `SPLIT_RELATIONSHIP_REQUEST_LIMIT`. The response echoes `splits` back with an `id` per entry, `[]` when there are none.
- [List payments](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/list): `GET /v1/payments`
- [Get payment](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/get): `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}` — paid PIX payments include a nullable `payer` block (name, document, institution name + ISPB) and `paidAt`.
- [Get payment by txId](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/get-by-txid): `GET /v1/payments/txid/{txId}`
- [Download boleto PDF](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/get-boleto): `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}/boleto`
- [Refund payment](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/refund): `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund`
- [List refunds](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/list-refunds): `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refunds`
- [Balance](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/balance/get): `GET /v1/balance` — a split credit received from another YuvexPay company follows **your own** rolling reserve policy, not the originating company's. Together with `GET /v1/documents/statements` this is the only public record a split recipient has of the money — the payment itself belongs to the originating company.
- [Create withdrawal](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/create): `POST /v1/withdrawals` — optional `destination.recipientDocument` (CPF/CNPJ of the PIX key holder); send it for any third-party payout.
- [List withdrawals](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/list): `GET /v1/withdrawals`
- [Get withdrawal](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/get): `GET /v1/withdrawals/{withdrawalId}`
- [Withdrawal limits](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/limits): `GET /v1/withdrawals/limits` — daily/nightly window, `minAmount` and `perTransactionLimit`.
- [Create product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/create): `POST /v1/products`
- [List products](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/list): `GET /v1/products`
- [Get product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/get): `GET /v1/products/{productId}`
- [Get product by external id](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/get-by-external-id): `GET /v1/products/external/{externalId}`
- [Update product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/update): `PATCH /v1/products/{productId}`
- [Delete product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/delete): `DELETE /v1/products/{productId}`
- [Upload product image](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/upload-image): `POST /v1/products/{productId}/image`
- [Delete product image](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/delete-image): `DELETE /v1/products/{productId}/image`
- [Create customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/create): `POST /v1/customers`
- [List customers](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/list): `GET /v1/customers`
- [Get customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/get): `GET /v1/customers/{customerId}` — `customerId` is a `cus_*` slug, not a UUID.
- [Update customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/update): `PATCH /v1/customers/{customerId}`
- [Delete customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/delete): `DELETE /v1/customers/{customerId}`
- [Payment receipt](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/documents/payment-receipt): `GET /v1/documents/payments/{paymentId}/receipt` — scoped to the key's environment; an id from the other environment returns `404`.
- [Withdrawal receipt](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/documents/withdrawal-receipt): `GET /v1/documents/withdrawals/{withdrawalId}/receipt` — same environment scoping.
- [Account statement](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/documents/statement): `GET /v1/documents/statements` — built from the real-money ledger, so a sandbox key always gets an empty statement.
